manual.storage_minecarts.line2: {0}{1}Storage Crates{2} can be placed into Minecarts, as with chests and hoppers.{3}
manual.storage_minecarts.line3: When placed into Minecarts, crates will act as they do outside, and store their items inside when they are broken, unlike chests.{0}
manual.storage_minecarts.line4: {0}{1}Storage Barrels{2} can be placed into Minecarts, as with chests and hoppers.{3}
manual.storage_minecarts.line5: When placed into Minecarts, barrels will act as they do outside, accepting fluids from bucketing and displaying fluid to containers.
